# TopologyAware_FlowScheduling

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A scheduling method that uses real-time topology state (link health, pod position) to prioritize flow routing across distributed SDN controllers. Enhances resilience and efficiency in dynamic rail networks, a key requirement for TCC's topology-centric communication models.
